description: Extracts FAQ question-answer pairs about the German Cannabis Act from the  Bundesgesundheitsministerium (Federal Ministry of Health) website.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_all: Fetch all FAQ Q&A pairs organized by section; 参数: 无; 必填: 无
  - search: Search for Q&A pairs matching a query string; 参数: limit, query; 必填: 无
  - get_section: Get all Q&A pairs from a named section; 参数: section; 必填: 无
  - get_qa: Get a specific Q&A pair by section and question index; 参数: section_index, qa_index; 必填: 无

limit.description: Maximum number of search results (used by 'search' function).

query.description: Search query string (required for 'search' function). Searches both questions and answers.

section.description: Section name for 'get_section' function (partial match, case-insensitive).

qa_index.description: Zero-based question index within section for 'get_qa' function.
